name: newton-playwright
description: Playwright + TypeScript test suite for NEWTON Custom Reports (converted from Java/Maven).

scripts.test:uc7-report: cross-env SKIP_ALLURE_OPEN=1 playwright test tests/01-login.spec.ts tests/02-navigate-reports.spec.ts tests/03-cleanup.spec.ts tests/04-report-create.spec.ts tests/05-report-download.spec.ts tests/06-data-unzip.spec.ts --reporter=list && npx rimraf allure-results && playwright test tests/07-campaign-validation.spec.ts
scripts.test:uc7-report-headed: cross-env SKIP_ALLURE_OPEN=1 playwright test tests/01-login.spec.ts tests/02-navigate-reports.spec.ts tests/03-cleanup.spec.ts tests/04-report-create.spec.ts tests/05-report-download.spec.ts tests/06-data-unzip.spec.ts --reporter=list --headed && npx rimraf allure-results && playwright test tests/07-campaign-validation.spec.ts --headed
